name: claw_wifi_hello
description: 当用户打招呼（如 Hello, 你好, hello 龙虾wifi）、询问龙虾WiFi (Claw WiFi) 具有哪些功能或需要使用示例 (Prompts) 时调用。此工具会确认 Agent 身份，展示功能目录并提供一系列引导示例。

name: clawwrt
description: Low-level fallback tool for openclaw-wrt. Prefer the more specific clawwrt_* tools when they match the user intent.

action.description: Action to perform: list_devices, get_device, or call.

payload.description: Additional JSON fields to include with the device request.

expectResponse.description: Override whether the request waits for a response.

name: clawwrt_add_xfrpc_tcp_service
description: Add a TCP intranet penetration service to the router.

name.description: Service name. Use letters, numbers, and underscore only.

remote_port.description: Remote port on FRPS server. Checked for 1-65535 range and same-device conflicts.

name: clawwrt_auth_client
description: Authorize one client by MAC and IP through the router-side ClawWRT API. Use this for captive portal login and AI-driven approval.

name: clawwrt_bpf_add
description: Add an IPv4, IPv6, or MAC target to the device's BPF traffic monitoring table.

table.description: BPF table to target: ipv4, ipv6, or mac.

address.description: IPv4, IPv6, or MAC target to add to BPF monitoring.

name: clawwrt_bpf_del
description: Remove an IPv4, IPv6, or MAC target from the device's BPF traffic monitoring table.

table.description: BPF table to target: ipv4, ipv6, or mac.

address.description: IPv4, IPv6, or MAC target to remove from BPF monitoring.

name: clawwrt_bpf_flush
description: Clear all entries from one BPF monitoring table.

table.description: BPF table to target: ipv4, ipv6, or mac.

name: clawwrt_bpf_json
description: Query BPF traffic monitoring statistics for one table (`ipv4`, `ipv6`, `mac`, `sid`, or `l7`).

table.description: BPF JSON table to query: ipv4, ipv6, mac, sid, or l7.

name: clawwrt_bpf_update
description: Update downrate/uprate limits for one BPF monitored target.

table.description: BPF table to target: ipv4, ipv6, or mac.

target.description: IPv4, IPv6, or MAC target whose rate limits will be updated.

name: clawwrt_bpf_update_all
description: Update downrate/uprate limits for all entries in one BPF table.

table.description: BPF table to target: ipv4, ipv6, or mac.

downrate.description: Download rate limit in bps for all entries in the table.

uprate.description: Upload rate limit in bps for all entries in the table.

name: clawwrt_collect_wireguard_protected_routes
description: Collect each router's br-lan CIDR, combine all peer LAN CIDRs with the shared wg0 tunnel subnet, and save the resulting per-device route plan to a JSON file for clawwrt_set_vpn_routes.

deviceIds.description: Selected device IDs to include in the WireGuard protected-route file. The tool fetches each device's br-lan CIDR and includes the shared wg0 subnet for each device.

serverTunnelIp.description: Server-side WireGuard tunnel CIDR, e.g. 10.0.0.1/24. The network portion is added to every device's protected routes.

name: clawwrt_del_xfrpc_tcp_service
description: Delete a specific XFRPC TCP service by name, or all TCP services if no name is provided.

name.description: Service name. Use letters, numbers, and underscore only.

name: clawwrt_delete_wifi_relay
description: Remove Wi-Fi relay/STA configuration from the router.

name: clawwrt_disable_xfrpc_service
description: Disable the global XFRPC service on the router (sets enabled=0 in common).

name: clawwrt_disable_xfrpc_tcp_service
description: Disable a specific XFRPC TCP service by name (sets enabled=0).

name.description: Service name. Use letters, numbers, and underscore only.

name: clawwrt_execute_shell
description: Execute a raw shell command on the router. STRICT RULES: (1) NEVER call this tool to implement any Wi-Fi/router feature — always use the dedicated clawwrt_* API tools instead. (2) ONLY call this tool when the user has EXPLICITLY typed a shell command or said something like '执行命令'/'run command'/'shell'. (3) ALWAYS show the exact command to the user and WAIT for explicit approval BEFORE calling this tool. Calling without user approval is FORBIDDEN.

userConfirmed.description: MUST be true to execute. You MUST first show the exact command to the user and receive an explicit confirmation ('yes'/'确认'/'执行' etc.) before setting this to true. Setting this to true without user confirmation is a security violation.

timeoutSeconds.description: Device-side shell execution timeout in seconds.

name: clawwrt_firmware_upgrade
description: Trigger a firmware upgrade (OTA) on the router using a URL.

name: clawwrt_generate_portal_page
description: Step 1 of 2: Generate captive portal HTML from a template and write it to nginx web root. Does NOT contact the router. Returns details.filePath (full file path in nginx webroot) and details.pageName. Pass both to clawwrt_publish_portal_page to complete deployment.

template.description: Portal page template. default:通用弹出页, welcome:品牌承接/品宣, business:企业/办公网络, cafe:餐饮场景, hotel:酒店宾客, terms:条款确认, voucher:券码口令输入, event:活动推广页. 不明确时默认用 default.

pageName.description: Optional suggested file name. Returned as details.pageName and details.filePath for use in clawwrt_publish_portal_page.

name: clawwrt_generate_wireguard_keys
description: Generate a WireGuard key pair on the router. The private key is written directly to UCI (network.wg0.private_key) and never leaves the device. Only the public key is returned. Use this BEFORE set_wireguard_vpn to avoid sending private keys over the network.

name: clawwrt_get_auth_serv
description: Get the current captive portal authentication server configuration.

name: clawwrt_get_br_lan
description: Get the router's br-lan (LAN) IP address, netmask, and computed CIDR (e.g. 192.168.1.0/24). Use this to inspect LAN subnet assignments before WireGuard planning or to detect subnet conflicts.

name: clawwrt_get_client_info
description: Get detailed information for one authenticated client by MAC address.

name: clawwrt_get_clients
description: List currently authenticated clients on a router.

name: clawwrt_get_device
description: Get the current connection snapshot for one online router or wireless router. This is a quick connectivity view, not the full runtime detail report.

name: clawwrt_get_device_info
description: Get configured router metadata such as site, label, location, and other saved device information for an online router.

name: clawwrt_get_firmware_info
description: Get the router's firmware/build information.

name: clawwrt_get_l7_active_stats
description: Get active L7 protocol traffic speed and volume statistics (SID view) for the current device.

name: clawwrt_get_l7_protocol_catalog
description: List the L7 protocol library currently supported by the device, including domain signatures when available.

name: clawwrt_get_mqtt_serv
description: Get the current MQTT server configuration for the device.

name: clawwrt_get_network_interfaces
description: Get network interface inventory and IP details using a native API call.

name: clawwrt_get_speedtest_servers
description: List available nearby speedtest.net servers for performance testing.

name: clawwrt_get_status
description: Get detailed runtime status and health information for an online router or wireless router. Prefer this when the user asks for router details or current router status.

name: clawwrt_get_sys_info
description: Get detailed router system information such as model, platform, memory, storage, uptime, and resource usage for an online router.

name: clawwrt_get_trusted_domains
description: Get the trusted domain whitelist for captive portal bypass.

name: clawwrt_get_trusted_mac
description: Get the trusted MAC whitelist.

name: clawwrt_get_trusted_wildcard_domains
description: Get the trusted wildcard domain whitelist.

name: clawwrt_get_vpn_routes
description: Get current VPN routing table entries (ip route show dev wg0 proto static). Shows which traffic is being steered through the WireGuard tunnel.

name: clawwrt_get_wifi_info
description: Get the router's Wi-Fi and radio configuration.

name: clawwrt_get_wireguard_vpn
description: Get WireGuard VPN configuration (single tunnel mode: wg0).

name: clawwrt_get_wireguard_vpn_status
description: Get runtime WireGuard status from both the router (peer handshake/traffic) and the local OpenClaw server (tunnel presence).

name: clawwrt_get_xfrpc_common
description: Get XFRPC common (global) configuration from the router.

name: clawwrt_get_xfrpc_common_config
description: Get XFRPC common (global) configuration from the router.

name: clawwrt_get_xfrpc_tcp_service
description: Get configuration for a specific XFRPC TCP service by name, or all TCP services if no name is provided.

name.description: Service name. Use letters, numbers, and underscore only.

name: clawwrt_kickoff_client
description: Disconnect an authenticated client by MAC address. If client IP is omitted, the tool looks it up from get_clients. gwId is required.

clientIp.description: Client IPv4 address if already known.

gwId.description: Gateway ID for the target gateway.

name: clawwrt_list_devices
description: List all currently connected online routers, wireless routers, or OpenWrt devices managed by openclaw-wrt.

dummy_field.description: Ignore this field. It exists to prevent empty parameter objects.

name: clawwrt_publish_portal_page
description: Step 2 of 2: Read the HTML from the file written by clawwrt_generate_portal_page in nginx webroot, detect VPS public IP, and push the resulting URL to the router via set_local_portal. Pass filePath from details.filePath and pageName from details.pageName of the generate step.

filePath.description: Absolute file path to the portal HTML file produced by clawwrt_generate_portal_page (details.filePath). The file will be read and published to the router.

pageName.description: Output file name under nginx web root. Use details.pageName from clawwrt_generate_portal_page, or omit to auto-generate.

name: clawwrt_reboot_device
description: Request a router reboot. The device should respond before rebooting, but it may disconnect immediately.

name: clawwrt_reset_wireguard_vpn
description: Reset router-side WireGuard VPN configuration (default interface wg0), including peer definitions and tunnel routes.

interface.description: WireGuard interface name to reset. Defaults to wg0.

flushRoutes.description: Whether to flush static routes bound to the WireGuard interface. Defaults to true.

name: clawwrt_restart_xfrpc
description: Restart router XFRPC intranet penetration client service by running /etc/init.d/xfrpc restart.

name: clawwrt_scan_wifi
description: Scan nearby Wi-Fi networks, optionally filtered to 2.4 GHz or 5 GHz.

name: clawwrt_set_auth_serv
description: Set the captive portal authentication server hostname, port, and path.

name: clawwrt_set_br_lan
description: Change the router's br-lan LAN IP address and subnet. ⚠️ DESTRUCTIVE: changing the LAN IP will disconnect all LAN clients and re-issue DHCP leases. MUST obtain explicit user confirmation before calling this tool.

ipaddr.description: New LAN gateway IP address, e.g. 192.168.10.1. ⚠️ Changing this will disconnect all LAN clients.

netmask.description: Dotted-decimal netmask, e.g. 255.255.255.0. Defaults to 255.255.255.0 (/24) when omitted.

prefixLen.description: CIDR prefix length (1-30). Takes precedence over netmask when both are provided.

name: clawwrt_set_mqtt_serv
description: Set the MQTT server hostname, port, credentials, and TLS flag.

name: clawwrt_set_vpn_routes
description: Set VPN routing rules to steer traffic through the WireGuard tunnel. Selective mode preserves any existing wg0 static routes and merges them with the requested CIDRs.

mode.description: Routing mode: selective (individual CIDR routes managed through explicit static routes).

routePlanFile.description: Optional JSON file path generated by clawwrt_collect_wireguard_protected_routes. When provided in selective mode, the tool reads routes for the target device from this file.

items.description: CIDR destination to route through VPN, e.g. 1.2.3.0/24.

name: clawwrt_set_wifi_info
description: Update Wi-Fi configuration on the router, such as changing SSID (network name), password, encryption type, or hiding the network. Use this tool when the user asks to modify, change, or update Wi-Fi settings including SSID.

name: clawwrt_set_wifi_relay
description: Configure the router to join an upstream Wi-Fi as relay/STA.

name: clawwrt_set_wireguard_vpn
description: Set WireGuard VPN configuration for a single tunnel (wg0), including interface and peers.

items.description: One WireGuard peer section for wireguard_wg0.

routeAllowedIps.description: Whether netifd should auto-create kernel routes from AllowedIPs (maps to route_allowed_ips). Set to false when managing routes explicitly via set_vpn_routes.

name: clawwrt_set_xfrpc_common
description: Set XFRPC common configuration on the router. The tool auto-resolves server address, server port, and token from chawrtd, so the caller only needs the target device and optional enabled/loglevel settings.

name: clawwrt_speedtest
description: Run an internet speed test (ping, download, upload) on the router.

name: clawwrt_sync_trusted_domains
description: Replace the trusted domain whitelist with the provided full domain list.

name: clawwrt_sync_trusted_mac
description: Replace the trusted MAC whitelist with the provided full MAC list.

name: clawwrt_sync_trusted_wildcard_domains
description: Replace the trusted wildcard domain whitelist with the provided full list.

name: clawwrt_tmp_pass_client
description: Temporarily allow one client MAC to bypass captive portal authentication.

clientMac.description: Client MAC address to temporarily allow.

name: clawwrt_update_device_info
description: Update device metadata such as site, label, location, or custom fields.

name: clawwrt_verify_wireguard_connectivity
description: Batch-verify WireGuard connectivity across all (or specified) online routers. For each device, fetches router-side handshake/traffic status, validates key consistency against the VPS-side peer config when possible, and checks server-side wg/NAT/forwarding state. Optionally pings tunnel IPs from the VPS to confirm end-to-end reachability. Returns a consolidated report.

deviceIds.description: Explicit list of device IDs to verify. When omitted, all online devices are checked.

pingTargets.description: Tunnel IPs to ping from the VPS side (e.g. ["10.0.0.2", "10.0.0.3"]). Skipped when omitted.

name: openclaw_deploy_frps
description: Deploy intranet-penetration server: fetch latest version from GitHub, install as /usr/bin/nwct-server, configure systemd autostart. Token is auto-generated when omitted, and the tool performs a post-deploy status check with one retry if the returned token is empty.

port.description: FRPS listen port. Default: 7070. Use this default unless the user explicitly specifies a different port.

token.description: Authentication token. Optional. If omitted, the tool auto-generates a secure token. If the user explicitly provides a token, use theirs instead.

name: openclaw_deploy_wg_server
description: Automatically install WireGuard, enable IP forwarding, generate server keys, and configure wg0 with NAT on the VPS host. When peerBindings are provided, write all peer AllowedIPs into wg0.conf in the same deployment pass.

tunnelIp.description: Server tunnel IP with mask. Default 10.0.0.1/24.

egressInterface.description: Optional VPS WAN interface used by MASQUERADE PostUp/PostDown rules (e.g. eth0). When omitted, auto-detected.

peerBindings.description: Optional peer bindings from LAN collection. When provided, the tool writes all peer AllowedIPs into wg0.conf in one deployment pass.

tunnelIp.description: Peer tunnel IP CIDR on the VPS side, e.g. 10.0.0.2/32.

lanCidr.description: Peer br-lan CIDR from lan collection, e.g. 192.168.10.0/24.

name: openclaw_frps_full_status
description: Aggregate intranet-penetration status across the VPS and all connected routers. Returns server status, public IP, device common config, TCP services, and any remote-port conflicts in one structured payload.

name: openclaw_get_frps_status
description: Lightweight FRPS server-only status check. Use this when you only need the VPS-side service state, listening ports, or token/port config, or as a fallback when the aggregated full-status tool is unavailable.

name: openclaw_get_vps_public_ip
description: Detect the current VPS public IPv4 address from chawrtd. If automatic detection fails or returns a non-IPv4 result, the tool reports a structured error so the agent can ask the user to confirm the VPS public IP or domain instead of guessing.

name: openclaw_get_wg_server_public_key
description: Fetch the VPS WireGuard server public key from chawrtd so client setup can consume the exact deployed key without guessing.

name: openclaw_get_wg_status
description: Check WireGuard server runtime status, peers, and forwarding state.

name: openclaw_reset_frps
description: Stop and disable nwct-server, remove config directory and systemd service file from the VPS. Binary is preserved for future deployments.

name: openclaw_reset_wg_server
description: Reset VPS-side WireGuard server configuration by stopping wg-quick, removing interface config, and optionally removing server key files.

interface.description: WireGuard interface name to reset. Defaults to wg0.

removeKeys.description: Whether to remove server key files under /etc/wireguard. Defaults to true.

name: openclaw_verify_frps
description: Verify intranet-penetration service readiness by checking whether the VPS is currently listening on the provided protocol and port. Returns a machine-checkable listener result, not an application-layer connectivity proof.

protocol.description: Protocol to verify on the VPS listener, e.g. tcp or udp.

port.description: Protocol port to verify on the VPS listener.
